root_causes.description: Payment service exhibits extreme memory usage (z=+43.85, window=1.384e+08) far above its baseline (1.378e+08±1.2e+04), causing degradation that propagates through checkout to frontend and shipping, generating their extreme error rates and latency spikes.

root_causes.description: Quote service shows extreme p99 latency (z>1000, window=2.605s) compared to baseline (1.98±2.7e-16s). As a dependency of shipping (per topology), quote latency propagates to shipping (z+701.96 latency, z>1000 error_rate) and then to frontend (z+657.73 latency, z>1000 error_rate), making quote the upstream root of the cascade.

evidence.observed_value: p99_latency_ms z>1000 at window mean vs baseline

root_causes.description: Frontend shows combined extreme error_rate (z>1000) and p99_latency_ms (z+657.73) anomalies, with elevated memory usage (z+2.12). These symptoms are consistent with propagated downstream failures from payment memory stress and quote latency, rather than an independent frontend issue.
